input.name: Fictional publishers sue Lumetric over training data

echoes.title: Publishers file suit against Lumetric over model training
echoes.summary: A group of fictional publishers filed a lawsuit claiming the fictional AI company Lumetric trained on their books without a license.

echoes.title: Lumetric says its training was lawful
echoes.summary: Lumetric said in a statement that it will contest the claims.
echoes.page: The statement says Lumetric used only material it believes it was entitled to use and that it will ask the court to dismiss the case. A first hearing has been scheduled; the company did not say whether it will settle.

echoes.title: What the Lumetric suit asks for
echoes.summary: The complaint seeks damages and an order to delete models trained on the books.

echoes.title: Lumetric suit: a summary for developers
echoes.summary: Developers using Lumetric's API ask whether the case affects them.
